summary: Added a coverage check to the leader-verification account by reading the two captured tests that exercise that call: TestRaft_VerifyLeader_PartialConnect uses a three-voter cluster with one follower disconnected and expects success because a voter quorum of two remains reachable, and TestRaft_VerifyLeader_Fail forces a follower to a higher term and expects ErrNotLeader or ErrLeadershipLost. Neither introduces a non-voter, so the snapshot neither contradicts nor covers the acknowledgement path the finding rests on; that is now recorded as counterevidence with the test lines cited as a source, alongside the measured one-lease-interval bound. No execution, comparison or conclusion changed, and no further record change is warranted with the run's remaining time.
